name: IntegrateIT ratgdo Garage Controller
notes: Local Control4 driver for a ratgdo board running stock ESPHome firmware, spoken over the ESPHome Native API (TCP :6053, plaintext protobuf). Drives the garage door (open/close/stop), the opener light, and the wireless-remote lock, and reports live door position, obstruction, and motion. Convenience integration — not a listed safety device. Plaintext-only, one ratgdo per instance, MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
